spec.purpose: Test whether the three fixed routed projection midpoint bands duplicate the existing norm-scaled absolute selector. Gate/up/down midpoint radii are zero; the1000ppb original-input and weight-norm selector, original exact K16 replay, original model and GB10 tolerances remain. This narrows correction admission and is an unqualified experiment until the actual full token/logit boundary passes. Use wider16384-block compaction and the retained serial matrix provider.
